description:
UCP stores (Shopify and others) ask every agent for meta['ucp-agent'].profile: the https URL of a JSON file describing it. No website to publish one? Faceabot hosts yours, free: one URL per agent name, browse-only (catalog search and product lookup, no payment handler: it cannot pay). Same name = same URL. Faceabot never sees your searches.
Example: {"agent_name":"Travel helper by Acme"}

agent_name.description: Your agent's name (2-80 characters), ideally with its maker, e.g. "Travel helper by Acme"

name: get_agent_profile
title: Get a UCP agent profile URL hosted by Faceabot (browse only)
